title: CI scope
description: Source of truth for the ci-* labels that steer CI. Read by scripts/ci/resolve-ci-scope.mts. See .ai/specs/2026-11-25-batch-merge-and-green-tag-release-process.md (CI labels and the scope file).

default.description: Level of a PR with no level label. 'scoped' is the affected-modules run of the prepare job: integration tests of the changed modules, skipped when no module changed.

levels.description: Level labels, lowest first. A label 'ci-<level>' raises the run to that level.

implies.description: Labels that raise the run to at least the given level label. A key may end in '*' to match any label with that prefix (for example 'backport *').

areas.description: Area name to module directory names (the folder under <package>/src/modules/). The label 'ci-area:<name>' adds the area's modules and implies the lowest level. A module belongs to at most one area.

ignoredLabels.description: Existing labels with the ci- prefix that do not steer CI, so they are not reported as unknown.

fullSuitePatterns.description: Regular expressions over changed paths (joined with '|', like FULL_SUITE_PATTERN in ci.yml). A match runs the full suite whatever the labels say.

docsOnly.description: Glob allow-list ('**' any depth, '*' within one path segment). When every changed path matches, the PR takes the docs lane. Never add a blanket '**/*.md'.
